scenarios.title: In the real Electrobun window with an isolated local agent/provider ID, Copy ID shows Copied for 1.5 seconds and delivers that provider ID to the macOS clipboard; restore the clipboard afterward.
Focus pane from Session Info activates the real application window and exact target tab/group/pane, flashes it, scrolls to the bottom and routes keyboard input only to that isolated target terminal.

Reveal transcript opens Finder selecting the captured transcript created under the disposable home, never a caller-supplied alternate path; return focus and close the Finder window created by this run.
